notes: Implemented Phase 2 (N-1) of the undo/redo review follow-ups plan. Extracted 8 inline Vue template expressions into 5 dedicated atomic handler methods: setTitleAlignment(), toggleTitleShowBackground() in createTitleHandlers.js; setBackgroundStyle(), removeBackgroundImageAtomic() in createBackgroundHandlers.js; removeOverlayAtomic() in createOverlayHandlers.js. Wired all 5 methods in createCollageMethods.js. Replaced all 8 inline expressions in index.html with single method calls. Key design decisions: checkbox changed from v-model to :checked to avoid Vue's v-model timing issue (v-model toggles before @change fires). Atomic methods include no-op guards (setTitleAlignment, setBackgroundStyle skip undo when value unchanged; removeBackgroundImageAtomic, removeOverlayAtomic return early when nothing to remove). Added 27 new tests in UndoExpansionTest.html (58 assertions) covering: undo command pushing, no-op guards, undo/redo state restoration, manager method calls, null onUndoCommand safety. Ran world-review which confirmed implementation is production-ready with no issues. All 43 test files pass (1546 tests, 0 failures).
